published_source: Printed article, Appendix Table E.5, column 5 (Omit Jun21) (appendix printed in the published article, Management Science 70(11), 2024, pp. 7363-7367; papers/mnsc/mnsc.2021.02026.pdf, text in data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2021.02026.txt); identical to the authors' full-data console log logPanelMainAnalysis_Lines339_351.txt (package code AppendixA54_ITT_RelTime_OmittingEachGroup.R (relative-time felm woJun21), stargazer TableA542 col 5). Printed rounding: 2 decimals (stargazer digits = 2; every SE prints as 0.01).

event_structure.source: AppendixA54_ITT_RelTime_OmittingEachGroup.R (relative-time felm woJun21), stargazer TableA542 col 5: felm(y ~ RelTrtWeek8pre + Pre7..Pre1 + Post1..Post7 + RelTrtWeek8onward | ID + WeekEndingDate | 0 | ID), RelTrtWeek = round((WeekEndingDate - TreatmentDate)/7), RelTrtWeek 0 omitted; the same code and bins as the main-text event study (PanelMainAnalysis.R lines 111-136). Bins recorded on relweek_m1 = RelTrtWeek - 1 (event_time_authors_var): authors' <=-8 -> <= -9, -7..-1 -> -8..-2, omitted 0 -> -1, +1..+7 -> 0..6, >=+8 -> >= 7. Structure copied from Fig_eventstudy_logSales.
event_structure.verified: TWFE with these bins on relweek_m1 reproduces the authors' 16 relative-week coefficients on the shipped 10% sample (max abs diff 0.0e+00, N 336,858); the printed full-data path cannot be re-estimated from the package.

presample_adopters_nov2: None (first access week 11 of 23). The Aug 8 group adopts after the panel (adoption_var gweek_true = 24).
adoption_var_note: Lead decision (Nov 2): adoption dates from the original treatment history. gweek_true = first week with WeekEndingDate >= TreatmentDate (same rule as gweek and SHaccess), extended past the panel: equal to gweek for the six in-window cohorts and 24 for the Aug 8, 2016 group (5,772 sellers), whose access falls after the last panel week (23). Within the sample D = SHaccess = 0 for that group (checked), so DiD-averaging treats it as never treated; its post-sample date is used only for event-time coding (TWFE leads, BJS lead regression), as in the authors' regression. Built by ~/did_packages/_work/mnsc.2021.02026/adopt_dates.R; gvar gweek (NA for the group) is kept.
event_time_authors_note: Lead decision (Nov 2): relweek_m1 = RelTrtWeek - 1, the authors' event week (round((WeekEndingDate - TreatmentDate)/7), PanelMainAnalysis.R lines 111-136) shifted so that their omitted week 0 is -1; defined for every seller (all have an access date, the Aug 8 group relative to Aug 8; no NA). TWFE indicators and the imputation estimator's bins use event_structure on relweek_m1; DiD-averaging (CSA) uses calendar rel = t - g (g from adoption_var gweek_true) with the same boundaries, which differs only for the May 12/19 cohorts (one week).
template_difference: Main-text event study Fig_eventstudy_logSales (Figure 4) re-estimated without the Jun21 access cohort (access date 2016-06-21, first treated week 17); same bins and omitted week; the Aug 8 group is always kept.
notes: PRINTED-APPENDIX SPECIFICATION (Nov 4, 2026): outside the main-text sample; for the appendix-inclusive sensitivity analysis. Main-text event study Fig_eventstudy_logSales (Figure 4) re-estimated without the Jun21 access cohort (access date 2016-06-21, first treated week 17); same bins and omitted week; the Aug 8 group is always kept. Event study: TWFE indicators and imputation bins on relweek_m1 (the authors' event week), DiD-averaging on calendar rel = t - g with g from gweek_true (Aug 8 group dated week 24, so it carries lead bins as in the authors' regression); calendar and authors' bins differ only for the May 12/19 cohorts (one week), as in Fig_eventstudy_logSales. published_coef/published_se are null as in the main-text event-study spec; the printed per-bin path is in published_event_coefs / published_event_se. Bar-Gill, Brynjolfsson and Hak (2024), eBay Seller Hub (SH) randomized staggered rollout. Seller x week panel, 23 Saturday week-ending dates 2016-03-05..2016-08-06. Treatment SHaccess = 1[WeekEndingDate >= TreatmentDate], absorbing; 6 in-window access cohorts (May 12, May 19, Jun 6, Jun 13, Jun 21, Jul 26 2016 = weeks 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 22) plus the Aug 8 group, never treated in-window. gvar = gweek (first panel week with SHaccess = 1, computed on the balanced panel before any restriction; NA for the Aug 8 group); D = 1[week >= gweek] equals SHaccess row by row. Seller FE + week FE, no controls, no weights, SE clustered by seller (authors: lfe::felm, exactDOF = T). DATA: the package ships a 10% random seller sample (18,422 of 184,222 sellers); the full data need eBay legal approval, so the printed full-data values can be reproduced only up to sampling error. Log outcomes precomputed in panel_sample_analysis*.rds (build_panel.R).
replication_status: approximate (random_subsample: fixest reproduces the authors' relative-week felm exactly on the shipped 10% sample; full-data path not reproducible from shipped data; printed values rounded to 2 decimals; 1 of 16 subsample bins beyond 1.96 subsample SEs of the printed value; post bins max |z| = 2.70)
